data.name: RTP_Desc
data.value: Tokenized picker for linking records through a native N:N relationship.

data.name: RTP_boundField_Desc
data.value: Any text column reserved for this control. It is never written to.

data.name: RTP_relationshipName_Desc
data.value: Schema name of the N:N relationship, e.g. new_account_contact. Everything else is discovered automatically.

data.name: RTP_subtitleAttributes_Desc
data.value: Optional comma-separated columns of the related table shown under the name, e.g. jobtitle,emailaddress1.

data.name: RTP_searchAttributes_Desc
data.value: Optional comma-separated columns matched with "starts with". Empty = the related table's primary name column.

data.name: RTP_includeInactiveRecords_Desc
data.value: Also suggest inactive records. Turn on for tables without a statecode column.

data.name: RTP_NoResults
data.value: No matching active records. Type at least {0} characters.

data.name: RTP_SaveFirst
data.value: Save this record before linking related records.

data.name: RTP_LoadFailed
data.value: Linked records could not be loaded. {0}

data.name: RTP_ErrPermission
data.value: You don't have permission to change these links.

data.name: RTP_ErrNetwork
data.value: Check your connection and try again.

data.name: RTP_ErrGeneric
data.value: Try again, or contact your administrator.

data.name: RTP_SearchAria
data.value: Search to add a linked record
